svg.title: Keep the last good report during an update
svg.desc: A report can be damaged if a job replaces it before checking all the new rows. Prepare. Write the candidate report to a separate temporary file. Validate. Check the rows and total while the previous report is still intact. Replace. Swap in the checked file only after it passes. A failed update leaves the last good report available.
